prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1920x1080 title-screen key visual for the original game Overbless
Input images: Image 1 is the approved player identity reference; Image 2 is the approved relative-scale and color-blocking reference for the player, red charger, violet archer, small green minion, and dungeon.
Primary request: Create the title key visual for an original 2D top-down action puzzle game about a saint who cannot attack and instead overblesses her enemies until they destroy each other.
Scene/backdrop: a dungeon hall seen from a slightly high three-quarter angle, cool dark-navy stone and dust, one warm amber light source low on the right. The left upper third stays deliberately quiet and low-contrast for a logotype. The lower strip across the full width falls into shadow.
Subject on the right: Rivella, age 22, an original cynical former saint. Preserve the approved cyan-and-black hooded silhouette and costume color blocking from Image 1, interpreted as a polished key-visual character. Amber eyes, a dry half-smile, a broken-halo talisman floating behind one shoulder, a long black-and-cyan coat with split tails. Her hands are empty and open in a seal-casting gesture, no weapon. She is calm, not heroic.
Behind and below her, preserve the approved relative scale and color identities from Image 2: three original silhouetted rivals are mid-attack against each other rather than against her: a red-lightning charge knight leaning into a straight dash, a violet eclipse archer holding a crescent greatbow along a horizontal firing lane, and a small lime-eyed cursed-doll swarm creature. Their attack telegraphs read as shapes, not colour alone: a thick straight line, a thin dotted line, a circular area.
Style/medium: painterly cel-anime illustration with subtle pixel-art lineage, clean readable shapes, restrained dungeon fantasy, no gore.
Lighting/mood: the moment just before her own blessing backfires; cool cyan, violet and ember-red accents against dark navy, warm amber rim light from lower right.
Composition/framing: exact 1920x1080, 16:9, full bleed. Rivella and action occupy the right 45-95 percent. Keep upper-left third quiet and low contrast for external logotype. Keep the entire lower strip dark enough for UI instructions.
Text: none.
Constraints: Original artwork only. Do not reproduce, imitate, or evoke any existing commercial character, costume, emblem, weapon silhouette, logo, or key-visual composition. Reject any result whose hair, costume, and colour blocking jointly resemble an existing published character. No text, no watermark, no signature, no UI mockup. Rivella has no weapon and does not attack. The enemies attack each other, not Rivella. Preserve reference identities without copying their reference-sheet layout.
Avoid: famous anime likenesses, parody composition, bright upper-left clutter, illegible silhouettes, gore, sexualized pose, text, logos, watermarks.
